About me

I work close to the numbers and close to the process.

I am a Finance Operations Specialist with 4+ years of experience across consulting, hospitality and healthcare. My background includes month-end close, AR, reconciliations, reporting, controls, process improvement and finance documentation across distributed teams.

I do not see finance operations as a set of isolated tasks. Close speed depends on upstream ownership. Cash visibility depends on AR and AP discipline. Reporting quality depends on reconciliations, controls and clean source data. That is the level at which I approach the work.
